InvoiceController.label: Invoice endpoints
InvoiceController.description: The web address the billing screens call to work with invoices.

InvoiceService.label: Invoice operations
InvoiceService.description: The rules for drafting, editing, sending and cancelling an invoice.

TaxCalculator.label: Tax rules
TaxCalculator.description: Works out what tax a customer owes based on the country they are billed in.

Invoice.label: Invoice
Invoice.description: A bill sent to a customer: who owes it, how much, when it is due, and where it has got to.

InvoiceRepository.label: Invoice records
InvoiceRepository.description: Reads and writes invoices in the billing database.

InvoiceEventPublisher.label: Invoice announcements
InvoiceEventPublisher.description: Tells other systems when an invoice goes out, and hears back when it is paid.

OverdueInvoiceJob.label: Overdue sweep

CreateInvoiceRequest.label: New invoice details
CreateInvoiceRequest.description: What a billing user must supply to raise an invoice.

InvoiceApiApplication.label: Invoice service
InvoiceApiApplication.description: The Java backend that runs invoicing.

invoices.label: Invoice records
invoices.description: Every invoice the business has raised.

InvoiceService.create.label: Draft an invoice
InvoiceService.create.description: Raises a new invoice for a customer, with tax worked out.

InvoiceService.update.label: Correct a draft
InvoiceService.update.description: Changes a draft invoice before it reaches the customer.

InvoiceService.send.label: Send to customer
InvoiceService.send.description: Locks the amounts, records the send date, and emails the invoice.

InvoiceService.delete.label: Cancel an invoice
InvoiceService.delete.description: Withdraws an invoice raised by mistake.

InvoiceService.requireBillingOwner.label: Account check
InvoiceService.requireBillingOwner.description: Only the account an invoice belongs to may send or cancel it.

TaxCalculator.taxFor.label: Work out the tax
TaxCalculator.taxFor.description: The tax owed on an amount for the customer's country.

TaxCalculator.treatmentFor.label: Explain the tax
TaxCalculator.treatmentFor.description: How tax is handled for this customer, in plain English.

OverdueInvoiceJob.markOverdueInvoices.label: Flag late invoices
OverdueInvoiceJob.markOverdueInvoices.description: Marks unpaid invoices past their due date so collections can chase them.

InvoiceEventPublisher.publishInvoiceSent.label: Announce the send
InvoiceEventPublisher.publishInvoiceSent.description: Tells the rest of the business an invoice has gone out.

InvoiceEventPublisher.onPaymentSettled.label: Record a payment
InvoiceEventPublisher.onPaymentSettled.description: Marks the invoice paid once the payment service confirms the money.

GET /api/invoices.label: List invoices
GET /api/invoices.description: The invoices a billing user can act on today.

POST /api/invoices.label: Raise an invoice
POST /api/invoices.description: Creates a new draft invoice for a customer.

PUT /api/invoices/:param.label: Correct an invoice
PUT /api/invoices/:param.description: Saves changes to a draft before it is sent.

POST /api/invoices/:param/send.label: Send an invoice
POST /api/invoices/:param/send.description: Sends the invoice to the customer and emails them the PDF.

DELETE /api/invoices/:param.label: Cancel an invoice
DELETE /api/invoices/:param.description: Withdraws an invoice that should never have been raised.

invoice.sent.label: Invoice sent
invoice.sent.description: Announced whenever an invoice goes out to a customer.

payment.settled.label: Payment received
payment.settled.description: Heard from the payments service when a customer pays.
